Scheme Name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College & University Students (CSSS)
Run By: Dept. of Higher Education, Ministry of Education (via NSP)
Relevant For (Education Background): UG and above college/university students selected on Class 12 board merit; renewal through course
Award Amount: Rs 10,000-Rs 20,000 per year by level
Application Mode: Online on NSP; Aadhaar OTR mandatory

Run By: Dept. of School Education, Ministry of Education (via NSP)
Relevant For (Education Background): Class 9 students (renewed Class 10-12) in govt/aided/local body schools; selected via state qualifying exam
Caste / Community (if specified): Open to all (5% marks relaxation for SC/ST)
Award Amount: Rs 12,000 per annum

Scheme Name: PM YASASVI - Top Class Education in Schools (OBC/EBC/DNT)
Run By: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (via NSP)
Relevant For (Education Background): Classes 9-12 in notified Top Class Schools; selection on previous class merit (entrance test discontinued)
Award Amount: Up to Rs 75,000/yr (Classes 9-10); up to Rs 1,25,000/yr (Classes 11-12)

Scheme Name: PM YASASVI - Top Class Education in College (OBC/EBC/DNT)
Run By: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (via NSP)
Relevant For (Education Background): OBC/EBC/DNT students admitted to notified institutions (IITs, IIMs, NITs, IIITs, AIIMS, NLUs, NIFT etc.)
Gender: All; 30% for girls; max 2 siblings per family
Award Amount: Tuition covered (ceiling Rs 2 lakh/yr private) + Rs 3,000/mo living + Rs 5,000 books + one-time laptop up to Rs 45,000

Run By: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (via NSP)
Relevant For (Education Background): OBC/EBC/DNT students in post-matriculation/post-secondary courses in recognised institutions
Award Amount: Academic allowance up to Rs 20,000/yr

Scheme Name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Central Sector)
Run By: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (via NSP)
Relevant For (Education Background): SC students from Class 11 up to PhD
Income Limit: < Rs 2.5 lakh/yr (per aggregator - confirm on NSP)
Award Amount: Rs 5,000-Rs 15,000/yr academic allowance + course fee support

Scheme Name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional & Technical Courses + Begum Hazrat Mahal (Minority Affairs)
Relevant For (Education Background): MCM: professional/technical course students of notified minority communities; Begum Hazrat Mahal: Class 9-12 minority girls
Caste / Community (if specified): Minority communities only (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
Award Amount: Up to Rs 20,000/yr (MCM); Rs 5,000-10,000 (BHM)

Scheme Name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship (Girl Students - Technical Education)
Relevant For (Education Background): Girl students in 1st year (or lateral-entry 2nd yr) of technical degree/diploma in AICTE-approved institutions; 5,000 degree + 5,000 diploma slots
Gender: Girls only (up to 2 girls per family)
Age Limit: No age restriction; gap between qualifying exam and admission <= 2 years
Cycle: Annual, up to 3-4 years with renewal
Award Amount: Rs 50,000 per annum (tuition, books, computer, stationery) by DBT

Relevant For (Education Background): Students with disability >= 40% in 1st year / lateral-entry degree or diploma in AICTE-approved institutions
Income Limit: Family income up to Rs 8 lakh/yr
Award Amount: Up to Rs 50,000/yr (fees, books, equipment, computer) by DBT

Relevant For (Education Background): 1st-year/lateral-entry degree or diploma students who are orphans, children of parents who died of COVID-19, children of war martyrs, or wards of parents with disability
Award Amount: Rs 50,000 per year consolidated

Scheme Name: AP Post Matric Scholarship - RTF (full fee reimbursement; formerly Jagananna Vidya Deevena)
Run By: Govt of Andhra Pradesh via Jnanabhumi portal
Relevant For (Education Background): AP-domicile students in post-Class-10 courses (Intermediate, ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, PG, professional) in govt/aided/private colleges (convener quota)
Caste / Community (if specified): SC, ST, BC, EBC (non-Kapu), Kapu, Minority, Differently Abled
Income Limit: <= Rs 2.5 lakh/yr (no limit for sanitation workers' children; exclusions: IT payers, govt employees, 4-wheeler owners etc.)
Award Amount: Full/100% tuition fee reimbursement (SC/ST full fee irrespective of course)
Application Mode: J-SAF via college principal + biometric authentication at MeeSeva; OTR on NSP by 31-Oct-2026
Deadline / Window (2026): AP application window expected Nov-Dec 2026; disbursement from Jan 2027

Scheme Name: AP Post Matric Scholarship - MTF (maintenance; formerly Jagananna Vasathi Deevena)
Run By: Govt of Andhra Pradesh via Jnanabhumi
Relevant For (Education Background): AP students in ITI, Polytechnic/Diploma, Degree and higher courses (day scholars and hostellers)
Caste / Community (if specified): SC, ST, BC, EBC, Kapu, Minority, Differently Abled
Cycle: Annual, paid in two equal instalments (~July and February)
Award Amount: Rs 10,000/yr (ITI); Rs 15,000/yr (Polytechnic); Rs 20,000/yr (Degree+) - DBT to mother's/guardian's Aadhaar-linked account
Application Mode: Jnanabhumi portal (J-SAF via college + MeeSeva biometric)

Relevant For (Education Background): AP students in Class 5 to Class 10
Caste / Community (if specified): SC, ST, BC, EBC, Minority, Kapu, Differently Abled
Income Limit: Generally up to Rs 2.5 lakh/yr (Rs 2 lakh for some SC/ST categories)
Award Amount: Maintenance/academic allowance (varies by class and board - confirm on portal)

Run By: Govt of Andhra Pradesh (School Education / Welfare Secretariat)
Relevant For (Education Background): Children in Classes I-XII (incl. Intermediate) in all recognised govt/aided/unaided/residential schools & junior colleges in AP; DBT to mother/guardian
Caste / Community (if specified): All students (SC/ST/BC/Minority students get CSS amounts first, balance under this scheme)
Gender: All children (paid to mother/guardian irrespective of number of children)
Income Limit: Eligibility via state household database (specific cut-off not stated in G.O.)
Award Amount: Rs 15,000 per child per annum via DBT to mother's/guardian's account
Application Mode: Data/DBT based via welfare departments (no individual application)
Deadline / Window (2026): Continued for AY 2026-27 per G.O.Ms.No.15 dated 16-Jul-2026; Class I & XI additions considered up to 25-Aug-2026
Official Website: AP Govt / School Education Dept portals

Relevant For (Education Background): Meritorious AP students in professional UG courses (Engg, Medicine, MBA, MCA, Pharmacy etc.) + UPSC civil services coaching sponsorship for graduates
Caste / Community (if specified): SC, ST, BC, EBC, Kapu and Minority communities
Cycle: Annual; renewal needs >= 60% marks without backlogs
Award Amount: Rs 20,000-Rs 30,000 tuition fee reimbursement; coaching incl. boarding stipend up to Rs 10,000 in 2 instalments; ~8,000 awards
Source(s): indiascholarships.in (aggregator - verify with AP Education Dept)

Relevant For (Education Background): Brahmin community students of AP from Class 1 to PG (levels: Class 1-5, 6-10, Intermediate/ITI/Polytechnic/D.Ed/D.Pharmacy, 3-yr Graduation incl. B.Ed); BTech needs EAMCET rank < 50,000
Caste / Community (if specified): Brahmin community only (also open to differently-abled, orphans, single-parent children in private schools)
Age Limit: Not specified for most levels (Class 1-5 listing: up to 18 years)
Cycle: Annual; PSS registration mandatory; must not receive other govt scholarships
Award Amount: Rs 5,000 (Class 1-5); Rs 7,000 (Class 6-10); Rs 10,000 (Intermediate); Rs 15,000 (Graduation)

Scheme Name: Veda Vyasa Scheme for Vedic Education (VV-VE)
Relevant For (Education Background): Brahmin students in full-time Vedic courses (Smartham, Moolam, Padam, Kramam, Jata, Ghanam) at Veda Patasalas registered with AP Endowments/TTD or enlisted by ABC
Cycle: Annual assistance for the duration of the Vedic course (1-6 years)
Award Amount: Rs 12,000-Rs 36,000/yr by course level (Smartham/Moolam Rs 12,000; Padam Rs 24,000; Kramam Rs 30,000; Jata/Ghanam Rs 36,000)
Application Mode: Online registration on ABC website (Scheme section)

Relevant For (Education Background): Brahmin toppers of AP - Class 10, Class 12, graduation, vocational courses and postgraduation
Cycle: Annual merit award (must not receive other scholarships)
Award Amount: Varies by level - confirm on ABC portal

Run By: Wipro Consumer Care & Wipro Cares (via Buddy4Study)
Relevant For (Education Background): Girl students from disadvantaged families in AP and Maharashtra who passed Class 10 & 12 from government schools and joined 1st year of full-time UG course
Income Limit: Disadvantaged family background (specific limit not stated - confirm on application page)
Award Amount: Rs 30,000 one-time

Relevant For (Education Background): Students who passed AP SSC/Class 10 in 2025-26 with 90%+ (9 CGPA); 75% (7.5 CGPA) for students with disability; now in Intermediate/Diploma; extendable to degree
Cycle: Two-year scholarship (Inter 1st + 2nd year), extendable to degree
Award Amount: Rs 10,000 for Class 11 (2026) + Rs 10,000 for Class 12 (2027); up to Rs 75,000/yr for higher studies
Deadline / Window (2026): Closed - last date was 20-Jun-2026 (screening test 5-Jul; interviews Jul-Aug 2026)

Relevant For (Education Background): First-year full-time UG students (any stream) at recognised Indian institutes; 5,000 scholarships nationally
Income Limit: Household income up to Rs 15 lakh/yr (preference to families earning < Rs 2.5 lakh)
Cycle: Multi-year for duration of degree; mandatory aptitude test
Award Amount: Up to Rs 2,00,000 over the degree + mentorship

Relevant For (Education Background): First-year full-time PG students in future-ready disciplines (CS, AI, Maths & Computing, EE, Chemical, Mechanical, Renewable Energy, Materials, Life Sciences); 100 scholarships; GATE 550-1000 or UG CGPA >= 7.5
Cycle: For the duration of the PG programme
Award Amount: Up to Rs 6,00,000 over the degree + mentoring, internships, alumni network
Deadline / Window (2026): Opened 14-Aug-2026; last date 05-Oct-2026 (references by 12-Oct; interviews Nov-Dec)

Relevant For (Education Background): Students in Class 1-12, Diploma, ITI, Polytechnic, UG or PG at risk of dropping out due to financial hardship/family crisis in past 3 years; min 55% in last qualifying exam
Income Limit: Annual family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh
Award Amount: Rs 15,000-Rs 75,000 per year by education level
Deadline / Window (2026): Cycle 1 extended to 31-Oct-2026; later cycles Nov/Dec 2026

Scheme Name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27 ('One in a Million')
Relevant For (Education Background): Girl students with >= 75% in Class 12 joining 1st-year professional UG (Engineering, MBBS, 5-yr Integrated LLB, Architecture, Design, BS-MS) at recognised institutes; 500 new scholars
Cycle: Renewable till completion of the degree
Award Amount: Rs 1,50,000 per year (fees, hostel, books, laptop)

Relevant For (Education Background): Students in Class 11-12 (PUC), ITI, Diploma, UG, PG, Engineering and Medical at recognised institutions (distance education not eligible)
Gender: All (higher rates for girls and differently-abled)
Cycle: Annual award, renewable; monthly assistance paid by DBT
Award Amount: Rs 500-Rs 3,600 per month by course and gender (PUC/ITI Rs 500-700; UG Rs 1,100-1,400; PG Rs 1,500-1,800; Engg/Medical Rs 2,800-3,600)
Application Mode: Online at SJF portal (no application fee)
Deadline / Window (2026): No strict deadline - apply soon after admission for 2026-27

Relevant For (Education Background): Top-20 rankers at admission (CAT/JEE Advanced/CLAT) at selected IIMs (A,B,C,L,K,Shillong), XLRI, IITs, BITS Pilani and top law schools (NLSIU, NALSAR, NUJS, GNLU, NLU Jodhpur, NLU Delhi)
Caste / Community (if specified): Open to all (pure merit; no income bar)
Cycle: Annual, renewable on academic excellence + leadership review
Award Amount: Management: Rs 3,00,000/yr; Engineering (IIT/BITS): Rs 1,50,000/yr; Law: Rs 1,80,000/yr (or actual fees, whichever lower)
Application Mode: Coordinated through institute Dean/Director (no direct application)
Deadline / Window (2026): Tentative ~10-Aug-2026 for 2026 cycle (confirm with Dean's office)

Relevant For (Education Background): Students from lower-income groups joining diploma courses (engineering and polytechnic) across India
Gender: All (preference to girl students, daughters of armed forces personnel - confirm on trust page)
Income Limit: Lower-income families (specific limit not stated - confirm on kcmet.org)
Cycle: Annual grant over the course duration
Award Amount: Varies by course/institution (historically ~ Rs 10,000/yr for diploma students - verify)
